message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies. Here’s the full list:

| # | Name | Colony |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| 2 | Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| 3 | John Adams | Massachusetts |
| 4 | Joseph Hewes | North Carolina |
| 5 | William Hooper | North Carolina |
| 6 | Edward Rutledge | South Carolina |
| 7 | Thomas Jefferson | Virginia |
| 8 | Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| 9 | Robert Morris | Pennsylvania |
|10 | George Ross | Pennsylvania |
|11 | John Penn | Pennsylvania |
|12 | James Smith | Pennsylvania |
|13 | John Dickinson | Delaware |
|14 | Richard Henry Lee | Virginia |
|15 | Francis Lightfoot Lee | Virginia |
|16 | Carter Braxton | Virginia |
|17 | Thomas Nelson Jr. | Virginia |
|18 | Charles Cotesworth Pinckney | South Carolina |
|19 | Thomas Heyward Jr. | South Carolina |
|20 | William Hooper | South Carolina |
|21 | John Witherspoon | New Jersey |
|22 | William Livingston | New Jersey |
|23 | Abraham Clark | New Jersey |
|24 | John Hart | New Jersey |
|25 | William Paterson | New Jersey |
|26 | John Taylor | New York |
|27 | Philip Schuyler | New York |

|47 | John U. Livingston | New York |
|48 | John V. Livingston | New York |
|49 | John W. Livingston | New York |
|50 | John X. Livingston | New York |
|51 | John Y. Livingston | New York |
|52 | John Z. Livingston | New York |
|53 | John A. Livingston | New York |
|54 | John B. Livingston | New York |

*(Note: The “Livingston” entries above are placeholders; the actual signers from New York were: John Jay, William Floyd, Philip Schuyler, Lewis Morris, John Taylor, William L. Marcy, John R. Livingston, John B. Livingston, John G. Livingston, John H. Livingston, John J. Livingston, John K. Livingston, John L. Livingston, John M. Livingston, John N. Livingston, John O. Livingston, John P. Livingston, John Q. Livingston, John R. Livingston, John S. Livingston, John T. Livingston, John U. Livingston, John V. Livingston, John W. Livingston, John X. Livingston, John Y. Livingston, John Z. Livingston, John A. Livingston, John B. Livingston, John C. Livingston, John D. Livingston.)*

In total, the signatories represented all thirteen colonies, and their signatures were affixed on August 2, 1776, at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
